licenses.text:
American Standard Version (1901), eBible.org, https://ebible.org/eng-asv/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this
translation):
> "American Standard Version (1901)
The American Standard Version of the Holy Bible, first published in 1901.
Public Domain
Language: English
Dialect: Archaic American

This public domain Bible translation is brought to you courtesy of eBible.org.
If you would like to make a donation to help keep free Bible access like this going, please visit https://eBible.org/give.php."

Why this is public domain:
First published in 1901 in the United States (Thomas Nelson & Sons). Its translators and revisers died in the early twentieth century, more than 70 years ago, so the work is public domain in the United States (published before 1931) and in its country of origin (life plus 70 years has long passed).

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain
text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source),
and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page
(https://ebible.org/details.php?id=eng-asv) and the edition's own files.

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
